input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: polish: /ask/ (2nd most-loaded page) tables stack as cards on phones, example questions in the empty panel

doc_friction.issue: Says the build takes 3 to 20 minutes; here it took about 3 to 4 minutes both times. Starting it before reading anything else, as the prompt says, worked well.

Screenshots taken 300 ms after load catch the hub's count-up stat tiles mid-animation ('Research projects 635' next to '1,080 research projects'). This looked like a data bug until I waited 3 s. Worth a line telling runs to wait about 2 s on the hub.

Starting the build wiped platform/pages/dist at once, so a page's 'before' HTML is gone unless it is copied first. I rebuilt a 'before' by stripping this diff from the new HTML. The polish prompt could tell runs to copy the pages they plan to change before rebuilding.

deviations.why: The queue's 34 open items were mostly audience pages at 320 to 360 px, worked over by about 15 runs on 2026-11-18. The prompt's own rule (pick the weakest surface a visitor is most likely to see) pointed to /ask/, the 2nd most-loaded page in site-visits.json, which no report had looked at.
deviations.did: Screenshotted the 4 most-loaded pages plus the prompt's 5 surfaces and fixed /ask/
deviations.result: 3 measurable defects fixed on a high-traffic page; the queue items are left for later runs

notes: Measured with Chromium over the full local build; 'before' = the same build with this diff's HTML and CSS removed. At 390: narrowest table cell 54 -> 328 px; tables overflowing their scroller 2 -> 0; gap from table to next paragraph 0 -> 18 px; blank space in the panel 183 -> 53 px; page 10,253 -> 10,172 px. At 320: page 11,801 -> 11,954 px. At 1280: tables unchanged; blank space in the panel 266 -> 220 px. No sideways scroll at 320, 390 or 1280. Each example question clicked with the rules engine gives a useful answer; 'eBay fees on a $40 sale' was dropped because bestPassage led with a blind-round table row. node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1827 of 1827 pass. node platform/pages/check.mjs: exit 0, 11,708 pages, no dead links.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a front-end dev auditing 9 pages, building responsive tables and an example-prompts row, measuring and writing up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
